findings.title: Replace the tautological page check.
findings.rationale:
n != 0 || n == 0 is true for every integer. The fallback at Line [25] is unreachable, and Offset(0) returns -s.rows. For the existing one-based formula, check that n > 0 before calculating the offset.

Proposed fix

-	if n != 0 || n == 0 { +	if n > 0 { return (n - 1) * s.rows } return 0
